title: Stream the row refresh
description: A data refresh switches to lazy iteration and adjusts its error path.
commitMessage: Avoid eagerly materializing remote rows and log the batch size.
reviewContext: Source.fetch returns a one-shot iterator and may raise ConnectionError while fetching or iterating. Refresh must save and return all fetched rows exactly once. Fetch failures must be raised to the caller, leaving saved data unchanged.

files.before:
import logging
from .source import Source

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

def refresh_rows(source: Source) -> list[str]:
    try:
        rows = list(source.fetch())
    except ConnectionError:
        logger.exception("Could not fetch rows")
        raise
    logger.info("Fetched %d rows", len(rows))
    source.save(rows)
    return rows
files.after:
import logging
from .source import Source

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

def refresh_rows(source: Source) -> list[str]:
    try:
        rows = source.fetch()
        logger.info("Fetched %d rows", sum(1 for _ in rows))
    except ConnectionError:
        logger.exception("Could not fetch rows")
        return []
    snapshot = list(rows)
    source.save(snapshot)
    return snapshot
